item.description:
Switches that belong together. A switch that is off in Settings now sits in the same cyan-to-pink ramp as the ones that are on, with the knob parked on the left, so the one row you have switched off no longer stands out as a black bar among its neighbours. A switch that is on carries a faint glow.

Missed a release? 0.17.9 added Redraft what you just said: Control+Option+R with nothing selected rewrites your last dictation in Draft, right where it landed, and Control+Option+Z puts your own words back. 0.17.8 made the app dictate through your Mac's own microphone and added a Microphone row in Settings with a live level bar. 0.17.7 added a Web Design pack. Every release, in order: github.com/romeo-golf-software/dictation-releases/releases.
